_readme: F-001 web QA fixtures — qa-web-agent, phase execute, 2026-08-16 (T-007e); English copy sync 2026-08-17 (T-070b).

T-070b (ADR-008 / owner decision 2026-08-17): the `hoàn tác` row was REMOVED from canonical_rows_used, not merely relabelled. It described itself as a 'voice-undo-guard tripwire', which was false after the decision retired the phrase: UNDO_PHRASES is now ['undo'] alone and src/assistant/api/ports/fixture-table.ts carries no row behind the Vietnamese phrase, so feeding it now yields no_match rather than an undo. This file is DERIVED — it is a map of which canonical/QA_EXTRA rows each web TC leans on, and fixture-table.ts + qa-test-server.ts's QA_EXTRA_ROWS are the sources of truth. Where the two disagree, they are the L-004 twin problem and the executable table wins; this file was corrected against it, never the other way round.

REWRITTEN from the authoring-phase draft. The authoring draft invented its own utterances (e.g. 'push the qaweb budget review to 4pm...'); the real server's Interpreter port is FixtureInterpreter bound to a STATIC canonical table (src/assistant/api/ports/fixture-table.ts) — an unmatched utterance always interprets as no_match. This file now maps every scenario onto that canonical table, extended by QA_EXTRA_ROWS (qa/assistant/automation/harness/qa-test-server.ts) for the handful of shapes the canonical table doesn't enumerate (exact 2-task delete boundary; two delayed rows for the cancel-while-thinking race). Both are the spec's own sanctioned extension mechanism (Test strategy: 'QA may extend it with their own rows via the FixtureInterpreter constructor').

Namespacing: seeded task titles use a qaweb-recognizable prefix WHERE the canonical/QA_EXTRA utterance lets us choose the title; utterances that target the canonical table's OWN fixed titles (e.g. 'Buy milk', 'Team meeting') necessarily use those exact strings — isolation still holds because task data is scoped per X-User-Id, not by title, and every TC uses its own qaweb-tc{n}@qa.example.com account.
normalizeTranscript (src/assistant/api/engine/normalize.ts) lowercases + trims + strips terminal punctuation — utterance casing in this file is cosmetic; the server normalizes before matching.

users.note: one account per TC (per sub-case where a TC has several); server state is in-memory per harness process, scoped per X-User-Id — no cross-test collision even when two TCs reuse the same canonical task title.

mark the shopping done.changes: status: done, all 3 in one turn

cause an ai error.note: always fails, no retry limit — not used (TC-028 uses the fail_times:1 row instead so retry can succeed)

undo.note: must NEVER reach interpretation — ADR-006 guard intercepts first. Since ADR-008 this is the ONLY member of AC-5's undo vocabulary (UNDO_PHRASES = ['undo'], src/assistant/api/engine/normalize.ts:9), so it is the only tripwire the guard can be probed with.

delete the qaweb pair.reason: canonical table has 1-target and 3-target delete rows but no exact 2-target row — needed for AC-9's >1-vs-1 boundary at its tightest edge

qaweb delayed bulk delete.reason: canonical table's only delay row is a create; AC-3 cancel-while-thinking needs a delayed QUESTION outcome too

qaweb delayed failure.reason: AC-3 cancel-while-thinking needs a delayed FAILED outcome too

qaweb delayed create.reason: added T-070b. TC-005 sub-case (a) used the canonical 60ms create row; 60ms is shorter than a Playwright click round-trip against the in-process server, so the thinking indicator (which owns the cancel pill) unmounted mid-click and the test failed ~1 run in 3 with 'element was detached from the DOM'. Triaged as a script race, not a product bug. Same 150ms remedy the two rows above already use — the assertion is unchanged in strength.

no_fixture_needed._note: any utterance NOT in the canonical table or QA_EXTRA_ROWS naturally interprets as no_match — no dedicated row required.

arbitrary partial transcripts while stil.used_for: AC-2 live transcript streaming, AC-3 cancel-while-listening

clarify_answers._note: a clarify question's candidate SELECTION (tap OR typed OR voice) resolves via FixtureInterpreter's early-return path — it matches the utterance against ctx.question.options directly (case-insensitive), before consulting any fixture row. Typing/saying the exact candidate title (e.g. 'Report Q1') resolves it with no dedicated row needed.

web_only_ac_out_of_scope_here.AC-15: list-question honesty ('what's on sunday' → unsupported_query) is api-tagged only per the spec's rev-3 retag (web-first decision); not exercised at the web layer
